Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Fish catch, Foraged food (dried), Fish catch (smoked). Muktar mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)

Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
